name: Release and Operations Artifact Completeness
description: A deployment is accompanied by release notes and active monitoring before reaching production, and every incident produces a root cause analysis, with recurring causes logged as known errors.

conditions.statement: Every Deployment Manifest or Deployment Package is accompanied by Release Notes / Change Log naming what changed.
Monitoring & Alerting Configuration exists and is active before a Deployment Package reaches production.
Every Incident Report / Post-Mortem produces a Root Cause Analysis Report, and a recurring cause is logged as a Known Error Record rather than re-investigated from scratch each time.
An App Store Submission Package includes the target platform's required metadata and passes automated store-compliance checks before submission.
